archive_note: Most of the entries are only static.

lines: I found a way to send messages to the past.
I don't know if this will work.
But I have to try.
I remember this place.
I remember how difficult everything seemed.
I wish I could go back and tell myself
that I made it.
If you're still listening...
Thank you.
I know I can't do much from here.
But I'm trying.
I went back to the forest today.
Not the real one. Just in my head.
It was smaller than I remembered.
I think that's how it works.
I stopped sending instructions a while ago.
You didn't need them.
I think I just wanted to keep talking
to someone who would understand.
I'm not sure who I'm writing to anymore.
Maybe it's still me.
Maybe it's someone sitting where I used to sit,
reading this a long way from here.
If it's you, the one who's reading this:
You don't owe me anything.
You don't owe this game anything.
Close it whenever you need to.

letter_title: LOG #100 — To Whoever Is Reading This
letter: Hello.
I don't know who you are.
I don't know where you are.
I don't know what you've been through.
And I won't pretend that I do.
But if you've made it this far,
then you've spent quite some time
with me.
Maybe you played because you were bored.
Maybe you wanted to see how the story ends.
Maybe you just wanted to beat the game.
That's okay.
I have something to tell you.
You don't have to be strong every day.
You don't have to know where you're going.
You don't have to fix everything
that's broken in your life.
And you certainly don't have to
prove anything to anyone.
Sometimes, getting through a day
is already enough.
I wish I could tell you
that tomorrow will be better.
But I can't promise that.
What I can say is that tomorrow
is a day you haven't experienced yet.
There are places you haven't seen.
People you haven't met.
Songs you haven't heard.
Stories you haven't read.
There are versions of yourself
that you haven't had the chance
to become.
So please...
Give yourself a little more time.
Not for me.
Not for this game.
Not because someone told you to.
Just for yourself.
Thank you for staying.
— Catherine
stay_prompt: Would you like to stay a little longer?
stay: We don't have to go anywhere.
